meta.title: Shop Safety
meta.subtitle: 15 rules. All 15 are on today's exam.

sections.blurb: Follow along. Nothing on the exam is outside this list.
sections.title: The 15 rules

blocks.title: Three things first
blocks.content:
1. You need **all 15 right** to pass. Miss one, you retake it.
2. **No machine** until you pass and Mr. Pina clears you.
3. Bring your **respirator** next class. Without it you are not in the shop.

### Gear

**1. Safety glasses on any time you are in the shop area.**
Not just when you are running something.

**2. Long hair tied back. Loose clothing tucked in. Jewelry off.**
Anything that hangs can get pulled in.

**3. Your respirator has to seal.**
If it feels loose, it is not protecting you. Fix it before you start.

**4. Every injury gets reported when it happens.**
Including the small ones.

### Permission

**5. No machine until you pass and get cleared.**
Watching the station video is only half of it. Feeling ready is not the same as being cleared.

**6. Never run a machine alone.**
No running machines in an empty shop, including open shop. Someone has to be there.

**7. Not sure if it is safe? Ask first.**
If you are not sure whether something is safe, stop and ask. Trying it slowly is still trying it.

### At the machine

**8. Find the emergency stop before you turn it on.**
If you cannot stop it fast, you are not ready to start it.

**9. Nothing goes into a running machine.**
Stop the machine first. Every time. That includes your hands.

**10. New sound, new smell, new vibration? Stop.**
Tell Mr. Pina. Do not finish the cut first.

### Other people

**11. Do not talk to someone mid-cut.**
Wait until they are finished.

**12. See something unsafe? Say something before they start.**
Any group, any machine. After they finish is too late to matter.

**13. Horseplay near a machine: tell them to stop.**
Tell them to stop. If they do not stop, tell Mr. Pina.

### The room

**14. Clean your station every day, even if it makes you late.**
The next person has to be able to work there.

**15. Finish early? Notebook, at your station.**
Stay at your station and start your notebook entry. Not another group's machine, and not a computer.

- All 15 right to pass. Miss one and you retake it.
- A retake happens at lunch today or at the start of the next class.
- No devices, no notes, no talking.
- Read each question all the way through. Some check whether you are paying attention.
- Everything on the exam is on this page.

Five machines. One part on each. The five parts assemble into a shop trophy that you keep.

Notes go in your engineering notebook. You will not have this page during the exam.
